sloka: तत्रैन्द्रेण च भागेन महीमाज्ञापयन्नृपः ।वारुणेन तु भागेन वपुः पुष्यति पार्थिवः ।। ७.७६.४४ ॥
transliteration: tatraindreṇa ca bhāgena mahīmājñāpayannṛpaḥ ।vāruṇena tu bhāgena vapuḥ puṣyati pārthivaḥ ।। 7.76.44 ॥

translations.english: There, the king rules the earth with the share of Indra, and with the share of Varuna, the king nourishes his body.
